name: Explain_3
short_caption: The robot extends its left hand forward, palm up, to explain a point or present an idea.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly lifts its left arm and extends it forward with an open, upward-facing palm. Its head tilts slightly toward the left to follow the hand's motion. After holding the open-palm pose for a moment to emphasize the explanation, the robot smoothly retracts its arm and returns to the initial neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The robot extends its left arm forward; ensure there are no obstacles or people directly in front of its left side.
